dishes.name: Brunsviger
dishes.desc: Sticky yeast cake with a brown-sugar and butter topping, baked in Aarhus and Funen bakeries and eaten with coffee.

dishes.name: Æblekage
dishes.desc: Layers of stewed apple, buttered crumbs and whipped cream. A traditional Danish dessert still served in Jutland cafes.

dishes.name: Stegt flæsk med persillesovs
dishes.desc: Fried pork belly with potatoes and parsley sauce. Voted Denmark's national dish and common on traditional Jutland menus.

dishes.name: Rugbrød
dishes.desc: Dense, sour dark rye bread that is the base of Danish lunch, baked in local bakeries and sold by the loaf.

dishes.name: Kanelsnegl
dishes.desc: Cinnamon swirl pastry baked fresh each morning in Aarhus bakeries, a regular companion to coffee.
